style.toneOfVoice: Create a cosy festive atmosphere with this pre-lit table Christmas tree. Featuring realistic PE and PVC tips with a snow-flocked finish, it captures the charm of a freshly frosted tree. Pre-strung with warm white LED lights, the battery-powered design allows you to place it almost anywhere indoors without trailing cables. The integrated construction makes the Christmas tree setup simple, while the flame-retardant materials and decorative wood-effect base complete a beautiful Christmas display. . Snow-flocked PE and PVC tips create a realistic winter appearance; . 488 tips form a full and natural-looking Christmas tree; . The pre-lit Christmas tree features 70 warm white LED lights for a welcoming festive glow; . Steady-on lighting creates a warm Christmas atmosphere; . Battery-powered design offers flexible indoor placement; . Decorative wood-effect base complements festive decor; . Flame-retardant PE tips, PVC tips and flocking for added safety; . Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, offices and other indoor spaces; . Colour: Green, White; . Light Colour: Warm White; . Material: PE, PVC, Metal, Plastic; . Overall Dimensions: F69 x 90H cm; . Base Dimensions: F19.5 x 19.5H cm; . Tip Count: 488; . LED Light Count: 70; . Power Supply: 4 x AA batteries (not included); . Item Label: 83C-282V00GN; . Shaping Note: Approx. 15-35 minutes of manual tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
